name.ja: BB戦士 300劉備(リュウビ)ガンダム

brands.ja: SD ガンダム BB戦士

description.ja: 三国志をモチーフにした新シリーズ「BB戦士三国伝 風雲豪傑編」の主人公“劉備ガンダム”が登場 背中の翼が左右に展開 二本の剣は背中の鞘に収納可能 鎧の着脱により軽装形態を再現 握り拳以外に、表情の付いた平手（左手）が付属 初回限定でBB戦士三国伝まるわかり漫画ポスターを同梱！
description.en: Introducing Liu Bei Gundam, the main character of the new series based on Romance of the Three Kingdoms, "BB Senshi Sangokuden: Wind and Cloud Goketsu". The wings on his back can be extended to the left and right. The two swords can be stored in the sheath on his back. He can recreate a lightly armored form by attaching and detaching the armor. In addition to the clenched fist, a palm (left hand) with an expression is included. A BB Senshi Sangokuden Manga poster is included for the first time only!
